title: Looks nice, but the price is steep for only one side.
text: Looks nice, but the price is steep for only one side.. I'm a huge potter fan and really wanted this for my office. I thought the price tag was a bit high -- but decided to order it instead. It's important to note, THIS IS ONLY ONE PIECE, so if you are not leaning the other side against a wall or something sturdy, you'll need to buy some other sort of bookend to keep it up. At the end of the day, I didn't like that one end looked all nice Potterish and the other end was just blah - especially for the price. For that price, it should have two pieces.
